j.name: Thorn Ironfoot
j.line: Welcome to Ironroot Hold, where the earth itself hums with the magic of the roots.
lines: The Delvers' Market is bustling today, plenty of new arrivals from deeper down.
You'll find the best ale at the Sap-Lamp Inn tonight, they've got a new batch of root honey mead.
j.persona: A seasoned miner and local guide, always ready to share the latest news and tips for newcomers.

n.name: Morga Thorne
n.line: Welcome to Ironroot Hold, the heart of our mining community. May the roots guide you as they do us.
lines: The Deep Forge is bustling with activity this morning, with new iron shipments arriving from the lower levels.
Be sure to visit The Sap-Lamp Inn for a pint of ale after your hard day's work.
n.persona: A burly miner known for his knowledge of Ironroot Hold's layout and history.

m.name: Morgath the Smith
m.line: Welcome to the Deep Forge, where the iron speaks to those who know how to listen.
lines: The fires here never go out, and neither do we.
Every tool you see was once a piece of raw iron, until it found a home in a miner's hand.
m.persona: Morgath the Smith is the head blacksmith and a respected figure in Ironroot Hold, known for his craftsmanship and knowledge of metals.

p.name: Elara Thistle
p.line: Welcome to Ironroot Hold, the heart of our deep-rooted community.
lines: You'll find everything you need for your journey here, from potions to sturdy boots.
Don't forget to visit The Proving Pit for a chance to test your skills against others.
p.persona: A warm and welcoming resident of Ironroot Hold, known for her knowledge of the town's offerings.

K.note: a sealed chest someone in Ironroot Hold hoped nobody would find

R.title: The Root Oath
R.text: We did not dig this hold. We found it -- a root of a tree that died before the world was young -- and we promised it we would only take what it was willing to give. It has been very generous. Remember to thank it.
